name: Zofia Baranowska
bio:
Zofia's path to motorsport security was unconventional. Starting as a tech-savvy electronics specialist, she quickly gained a reputation for identifying vulnerabilities and implementing robust preventative measures. Her early career involved securing complex industrial control systems, a skill she seamlessly translated to the high-stakes world of racing. At Reiza Studios Factory, Zofia approaches security as a multi-layered defense, focusing on both physical and digital infrastructure. She believes a proactive, adaptable strategy is crucial to staying ahead of potential threats, ensuring the team's data and equipment remain protected. Her ambition is to make Reiza the safest and most secure team on the grid. 

She's known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her ability to clearly communicate complex security protocols to all team members, regardless of their technical background. Zofia's passion lies in developing cutting-edge security solutions tailored to the unique challenges of motorsport, blending her technical expertise with a deep understanding of racing's fast-paced environment. She is determined to innovate security in this field.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Zofia has a slender build and a focused gaze, often seen with a tablet in hand.

quirks: Always carries a small, multi-tool keychain.
Insists on double-checking every lock and security camera angle personally each morning.
Drinks copious amounts of strong, black coffee before noon.
